summary: RelationDAG orchestrator: manages named relations with dependency_edges and constraint_edges (two-edge-graph-model). Supports topological collection, FK validation, and DataPackage interop. Pure orchestration over existing visitor (+1 ref_resolver param, +2 leaf nodes).

key_classes.name: RelationDAG
key_classes.purpose: Named relation container with dependency/constraint edge sets; collect() walks dependencies topologically

key_classes.name: ResourceRef
key_classes.purpose: Wrapper for tabular + non-tabular resource references in DataPackage context

key_functions.name: RelationDAG.add(name, relation)
key_functions.purpose: Register a named relation; auto-discovers dependency edges from RefRelNodes

key_functions.name: RelationDAG.ref(name)
key_functions.purpose: Create RefRelNode pointing to a named relation

key_functions.name: RelationDAG.collect(name)
key_functions.purpose: Topologically walk dependencies, materialise each upstream once, compile target

key_functions.name: RelationDAG.to_package()
key_functions.purpose: Export DAG back to Frictionless DataPackage descriptor

lifecycle_notes: Two-edge-graph-model: dependency_edges drive collect() execution, constraint_edges are FK metadata only
DataPackage from disk yields N nodes with zero dependency edges — every resource independently loadable
risks: ResourceReadRelNode requires DataResource with valid path or data
